home.faqSub: And answers so honest they hurt.

faq.question: What will the money be used for?
faq.answer: 100% goes to a humanitarian cause: feeding me. Financial reports are published as photos of food.

faq.question: Is this fund licensed?
faq.answer: No. But there is a driving licence, if that makes you feel better.

faq.question: Can I get a refund?
faq.answer: You will be refunded with a heartfelt thank you, possibly with a sticker.

faq.question: Is this a scam?
faq.answer: No, this is a public, transparent and shameless begging page. You know exactly who you're feeding.
